deQR performance gate

500 images, of which exactly 3 are real QR codes (outlined in teal). Open DevTools -> Performance, record while scrolling to the bottom, then read the counters below.

images on page: ...
real QR codes: 3 - all three must end up badged
pass criteria: stage-1 p95 < 1.5ms | exactly 3 messages to the background | no long task > 50ms while scrolling
scroll to the bottom, then press Measure.

The number that matters is how many images reach the background. The prefilter exists so that number is 3 and not 500: every crossing is a serialize-and-copy, since Chrome's runtime messaging is JSON. If the count is much above 3, the ratio tolerance is too loose. If fewer than 3 images end up badged, the filter is too tight, which is worse.
